items.title: Nick Brignola interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 28, 1997
items.q: I never listened to Serge Chaloff. I mean Serge died when I first started to play... I heard about him, and the few times I heard him, he didn’t knock me out.

ctx.x: He had quite a character on baritone for a while, was it Serge?
Oh, yeah, I heard all the Serge stories.
Chaloff is it? © Fillius Jazz Archive -19-
